q1_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT drinker FROM frequents NATURAL JOIN serves WHERE beer = 'Corona' AND NOT drinker IN (SELECT drinker FROM Likes WHERE beer = 'Corona')
explanation: Q1 finds drinkers who frequent bars serving 'Corona' but do not like 'Corona'. Q2 finds all drinkers who like any beer other than 'Corona'. A drinker not in Likes at all (e.g., Alice) will be in Q1 if she frequents a bar serving Corona but not in Q2. A drinker in Likes for another beer (e.g., Bob) will be in Q2 but not in Q1 if they don't frequent bars serving Corona.
